goal: Generate a 3:4 vertical main visual for a cultural exhibition, suitable for main posters, invitations, and online hero images, with bilingual text that feels natural, not just simple machine translation.

title_block.subtitle_zh: Contemporary East and West Craft Exchange Annual Exhibition
title_block.subtitle_en: A Contemporary Survey of East-West Craft
title_block.alignment: Upper left and upper middle blocks left-aligned, main title slightly above vertical golden ratio, English subtitle width not exceeding Chinese title width
title_block.hierarchy_rule: Chinese main title > English main line > Chinese subtitle > English subtitle > meta information line.

main_visual.description: Bottom right 45% area features low-poly landscape silhouette with straightedge and compass line overlay, not imitating any single artist's signature, using red ochre blocks, ink lines, and breathing white space
main_visual.position: Bottom right large area, upper edge roughly aligned with the central axis of the main title, not crossing through title letters

design.zh_font: Modern Song typeface, title in weight 700, body 400
design.en_font: Cormorant Garamond or similar modern serif for main and secondary English lines, metadata can be switched to Source Serif 4 small size
design.grid: 12-column grid, main title occupies columns 1-6, main visuals 7-12, final draft does not display grid lines

must_keep: Chinese fonts and Latin font shapes originate from clearly different sources and do not share the same file for mixed typesetting.
The English translation semantically corresponds to the Chinese exhibition name rather than translating each word literally
Leave white space no less than 20% of the image.
avoid: The Chinese title directly uses western sans-serif type.
The font size of the English subtitle is close to the Chinese title
Pile QR Codes and Six Sponsorship Logos in the Corner (Additional Materials Can Be Created if Needed)
